vehicles.summary: The best-selling nameplate in automotive history: efficient, reliable, and loaded with standard Toyota Safety Sense 3.0.
A sportier, more practical take on the Corolla with a 2.0L Dynamic Force engine and a usable hatch.
Gazoo Racing's rally-bred hot hatch: a 300-hp turbo three-cylinder and GR-FOUR adjustable all-wheel drive.

The hybrid icon, reinvented with a sleek design, up to 57 mpg, and a 220-hp Plug-in Hybrid with 44 miles of EV range.
Toyota's flagship sedan with a raised crossover stance, standard AWD, and an available 340-hp Hybrid MAX powertrain.
An affordable, lightweight rear-drive 2+2 coupe with a 2.4L boxer engine, co-developed with Subaru.
